description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_SafeObject' that extends 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform'. The class is responsible for setting default 'type' attribute values for objects, specifically supporting flash objects.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_SafeObject
classes.description: A class to write default type attribute values for objects, primarily for Flash.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Sets the default 'type' attribute to 'application/x-shockwave-flash' if it is not already set.
